### Imports

```{r}
library(readr)
```


### Reading in the data

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

water <- read_csv("data/water_potability.csv")

water <- water %>%
  mutate(Potability = factor(Potability))
```

### Initial exploration

Let's begin by examining the dimensions and structure of the dataset.

```{r}
dim(water)
glimpse(water)
```

Next, preview the first few observations.

```{r}
head(water)
```

Check the amount of missing data in each variable.

```{r}
colSums(is.na(water))
```

Finally, examine summary statistics for each variable.

```{r}
summary(water)
```
